import {wordPronunciationReport,wordPronunciationReportStyles} from './word-pronunciation-report';
import {namePhoneticReviewsReport,namePhoneticReportStyles} from './name-phonetic-report';
import {elementAssessmentReport,elementAssessmentReportStyles} from './element-assessment-report';
import {modernPracticalEvidenceReport} from '../shared/modern-practical-evidence';
import type { NamingSession, StudioSettings } from '../shared/types';
import { parentNameReference } from '../domain/naming';
import { getReportCandidates } from '../shared/workflow';
import { sessionBatchLabel } from '../shared/session-catalog';
import {numerologyReport} from './numerology-report';
import { qimenAuxiliaryReport } from './qimen-report';
import { qimenPatternsReport, qimenPatternsReportStyles } from './qimen-patterns-report';
import { sessionSourcesReport, sessionSourcesReportStyles } from './session-sources-report';
import { baziEvidenceReport, baziEvidenceReportStyles } from './bazi-evidence-report';
import {qimenStemTombsReport,qimenStemTombsReportStyles} from './qimen-stem-tombs-report';
import {birthTimeReport,birthTimeReportStyles} from './birth-time-report';
import {followingRestrictionsReport,followingRestrictionsReportStyles} from './following-restrictions-report';
import {ditianRenReport,ditianRenReportStyles} from './ditian-ren-report';
import {nameImageryReport,nameImageryReportStyles} from './name-imagery-report';
import {yueReadingReport,yueReadingReportStyles} from './yue-reading-report';
import {yueHomophoneReport,yueHomophoneReportStyles} from './yue-homophone-report';
import {namingMeaningReviewReport,namingMeaningReviewReportStyles,namingMeaningReviewV71ReportStyles} from './naming-meaning-review-report';
import {meaningContextReviewReport,meaningContextReportStyles} from './meaning-context-report';
import {dictionaryReadingReport,dictionaryReadingReportStyles} from './dictionary-reading-report';
import {NAMING_RULE_V6_VERSION,NAMING_RULE_V7_VERSION,NAMING_RULE_V71_VERSION} from '../shared/naming-rules';
const esc=(v:unknown)=>String(v??'').replace(/[&<>"']/g,c=>({'&':'&amp;','<':'&lt;','>':'&gt;','"':'&quot;',"'":'&#39;'}[c]!));
export function reportHTML(s:NamingSession,settings:StudioSettings){
  const b=s.analysis.bazi,q=s.analysis.qimen,p=s.profile;
  const parental=parentNameReference(p,s.preferences);
  const names=getReportCandidates(s);
  const logo=/^data:image\/(png|jpeg|webp);base64,[A-Za-z0-9+/=]+$/.test(settings.logoDataUrl)?`<img class="logo" src="${settings.logoDataUrl}">`:'';
  const lines=(xs:string[])=>xs.map(x=>`<li>${esc(x)}</li>`).join('');
  const pausedEvidence=!b.evidence&&b.timeBasis?.dayStatus==='uncertain';
  const unavailableQimen=`<p class="muted">奇门：${esc(q.reason)}</p>`;
  return `<!doctype html><html lang="zh-CN"><head><meta charset="UTF-8"><meta http-equiv="Content-Security-Policy" content="default-src 'none'; style-src 'unsafe-inline'; img-src data:"><title>命名方案</title><style>
  @page{size:A4;margin:18mm 16mm 18mm}*{box-sizing:border-box}body{font-family:'Microsoft YaHei','Noto Sans CJK SC',sans-serif;font-size:10pt;line-height:1.75;color:#263c35;margin:0}h1,h2,h3{font-family:'Noto Serif SC','SimSun',serif;font-weight:600}h1{font-size:29pt;letter-spacing:3px;margin:10px 0}h2{font-size:16pt;margin:20px 0 9px}h3{font-size:22pt;letter-spacing:5px;margin:0;color:#234c3e}.eyebrow{color:#99804e;letter-spacing:3px;font-size:9pt}.header{border-bottom:2px solid #234c3e;padding:8px 0 20px}.logo{float:right;max-width:95px;max-height:70px}.muted{color:#718078;font-size:9pt}.grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:8px 25px}.card{border:1px solid #d9dfd9;border-radius:8px;padding:17px 20px;margin:0 0 16px;break-inside:avoid}.candidate{break-before:page}.candidate h2{margin-top:0}p{margin:7px 0}ul{margin:5px 0;padding-left:20px}table{width:100%;border-collapse:collapse;font-size:9pt}th,td{border:1px solid #d9dfd9;text-align:left;padding:8px;vertical-align:top}th{background:#f1f4ee}.quote{background:#f5f3ec;border-left:3px solid #b69962;padding:9px 13px}.tag{font-size:9pt;color:#99804e}.note{white-space:pre-wrap}.footer{margin-top:20px;border-top:1px solid #d9dfd9;padding-top:9px;font-size:8pt;color:#7c857f}.qimen td{width:33.33%;height:85px}.coverNames{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:9px 20px;font-family:SimSun,serif;font-size:19pt;line-height:2;letter-spacing:3px}.coverName{white-space:nowrap}.analysis{break-before:page}.analysis>h2:first-child{margin-top:0}.qimen-section{break-before:page}.qimen-section>h2:first-child{margin-top:0}.numerology-report{break-before:page;font-size:9pt;line-height:1.55}.numerology-report h2{font-size:14pt;margin:12px 0 7px}.numerology-report h2:first-child{margin-top:0}.numerology-report table{font-size:8pt;line-height:1.5}.numerology-report td,.numerology-report th{padding:6px;overflow-wrap:anywhere}.numerology-report table:first-of-type th:first-child{width:46px}.numerology-report table:first-of-type th:nth-child(2){width:110px}.numerology-report p{margin:6px 0}.revision{border-top:1px dashed #d9dfd9;margin-top:10px;padding-top:9px}.qimen-auxiliary-report{break-before:page;font-size:9pt;line-height:1.5}.qimen-auxiliary-report>h2:first-child{margin-top:0}.qimen-auxiliary-report h2{font-size:14pt;margin:15px 0 8px}.qimen-auxiliary-report table{font-size:8pt}.qimen-auxiliary-report th,.qimen-auxiliary-report td{padding:6px;overflow-wrap:anywhere}.qimen-auxiliary-report p{margin:5px 0}.qimen-auxiliary-report .muted{font-size:8pt}.qimen-auxiliary-report li{overflow-wrap:anywhere}.qimen-marker-evidence,.qimen-rule-evidence{break-inside:avoid;margin:8px 0}${qimenPatternsReportStyles}${sessionSourcesReportStyles}${baziEvidenceReportStyles}${qimenStemTombsReportStyles}${birthTimeReportStyles}${followingRestrictionsReportStyles}${ditianRenReportStyles}${nameImageryReportStyles}${yueReadingReportStyles}${yueHomophoneReportStyles}${names.some(candidate=>candidate.namePhoneticReviews)?namePhoneticReportStyles:''}.paused-analysis-summary{break-inside:avoid;margin-top:14px}.bazi-evidence-report.bazi-evidence-report-paused{break-before:auto;margin-top:0}${[NAMING_RULE_V6_VERSION,NAMING_RULE_V7_VERSION].includes(s.namingRules?.version as typeof NAMING_RULE_V6_VERSION|typeof NAMING_RULE_V7_VERSION)?dictionaryReadingReportStyles:''}${s.namingRules?.version===NAMING_RULE_V7_VERSION?namingMeaningReviewReportStyles:s.namingRules?.version===NAMING_RULE_V71_VERSION?namingMeaningReviewReportStyles+namingMeaningReviewV71ReportStyles:''}${s.preferences.elementAssessment===true?elementAssessmentReportStyles:''}${s.preferences.wordPronunciationReference===true?wordPronunciationReportStyles:''}${s.candidates.some(c=>c.meaningContextReview)?meaningContextReportStyles:''}</style></head><body>
  <header class="header">${logo}<div class="eyebrow">ZHIMING · NAMING STUDIO</div><h1>${esc(settings.studioName||'知名起名工作室')}</h1><div>新生儿个性化命名方案</div><div class="muted">方案日期 ${esc(new Date(s.createdAt).toLocaleDateString('zh-CN',{timeZone:'Asia/Shanghai'}))} · ${esc(sessionBatchLabel(s))}</div></header>
  <h2>一份名字，一份期许</h2><div class="grid"><p>客户：${esc(p.customerName||'未填写')}<br>姓氏：${esc(p.surname)} · 风格：${esc(s.preferences.style)}</p><p>出生：${esc(b.solarDate)}<br>地点：${esc(p.birthPlace)} · ${esc(p.timezone)}</p></div>
  ${p.fatherName||p.motherName?`<p>爸爸姓名：${esc(p.fatherName||'未填写')}　妈妈姓名：${esc(p.motherName||'未填写')}</p><p class="muted">父母用字避讳：${s.preferences.avoidParentNames===false?'未启用':parental.excluded?`已避开${esc([...parental.excluded].join('、'))}（常见中文姓氏不计入）`:'尚无可自动识别的避字'}${parental.warnings.length?'；'+esc(parental.warnings.join('；')):''}</p>`:''}
  <p>命名期许：${esc(s.preferences.meanings||'自然、美好、易于读写')}</p><p>指定/辈分字：${esc(s.preferences.requiredChars||'无')} / ${esc(s.preferences.generationChar||'无')}；避讳：${esc(s.preferences.forbiddenChars+s.preferences.elderTaboo||'无')}</p>
  <div class="card"><div class="tag">${names.length} 个${s.candidates.some(c=>c.favorite)?'收藏':'候选'}名字</div><div class="coverNames">${names.map(c=>`<span class="coverName">${esc(c.fullName)}</span>`).join('')}</div></div>
  <section class="analysis"><h2>八字与用字参考</h2>${b.pillars.length?`<table><tr>${b.pillars.map(x=>`<th>${esc(x.label)}</th>`).join('')}</tr><tr>${b.pillars.map(x=>`<td>${esc(x.gan+x.zhi)}<br>${esc(x.element)}<br>藏干 ${esc(x.hidden.join('、'))}</td>`).join('')}</tr></table>`:'<p>当前出生区间内没有可统一确定的柱；请补全时刻后重新分析。</p>'}
  <p>生肖：${esc(b.zodiac)} · 农历：${esc(b.lunarDate)}<br>五行基础分布：${esc(Object.entries(b.elements).map(([e,n])=>e+' '+n).join(' / '))}<br>系统喜用候选：${esc(s.originalFavorable.join('、')||'未提出')}；本方案采用：${esc((s.preferences.preferredElements.length?s.preferences.preferredElements:b.favorable).join('、')||'未提出')}</p><ul>${lines(b.reasons)}</ul><p>${esc(b.seasonalAdvice)}</p><p class="muted">${esc(b.ruleDescription)}<br>${esc(b.warnings.join('；'))}</p>
  ${pausedEvidence?`<div class="paused-analysis-summary">${baziEvidenceReport(b.evidence,b.timeBasis)}${!q.available?unavailableQimen:''}</div>`:''}${birthTimeReport(b.timeBasis)}${!pausedEvidence?baziEvidenceReport(b.evidence,b.timeBasis):''}${followingRestrictionsReport(b.monthFollowingRestrictions)}${s.analysis.renCommentary?.actionAnalysis&&!q.available&&!pausedEvidence?unavailableQimen:''}${ditianRenReport(s.analysis.renCommentary)}${q.available?`<div class="qimen-section"><h2>奇门出生参考盘</h2><p>${esc(q.dun)} ${q.ju} 局 · ${esc(q.yuan)} · ${esc(q.solarTerm)} · 旬首 ${esc(q.xun)}<br>值符 ${esc(q.chiefStar)} · 值使 ${esc(q.chiefDoor)}</p><table class="qimen">${[[4,9,2],[3,5,7],[8,1,6]].map(row=>`<tr>${row.map(n=>{const c=q.palaces.find(x=>x.number===n);return `<td>${c?`<b>${esc(c.trigram)} ${n} · ${esc(c.direction)}</b><br>${esc(c.star)} / ${esc(c.door)} / ${esc(c.god)}<br>天 ${esc(c.heaven)} · 地 ${esc(c.earth)}<br>${esc(c.marks.join('、'))}`:''}</td>`;}).join('')}</tr>`).join('')}</table><p class="muted">${esc(q.reasons.join('；'))}<br>${esc(q.warnings.join('；'))}</p></div>`:(pausedEvidence||s.analysis.renCommentary?.actionAnalysis?'':unavailableQimen)}
  ${qimenAuxiliaryReport(q)}${qimenPatternsReport(q)}${qimenStemTombsReport(q)}</section>${names.map((c,i)=>`<section class="candidate"><div class="eyebrow">候选 ${String(i+1).padStart(2,'0')} · ${esc(c.style)}</div><h3>${esc(c.fullName)}</h3><p class="muted">${esc(c.pinyin)} · ${c.origin==='ai'?'AI 辅助生成':'本地字库组合'}</p><div class="card"><b>字义与整体寓意</b><p class="note">${esc(c.meaning)}</p><b>推荐理由</b><p>${esc(c.reason)}</p></div>${dictionaryReadingReport(c.characters,s.namingRules?.version)}${namingMeaningReviewReport(c.namingMeaningReview,c.givenName,s.namingRules?.version)}${meaningContextReviewReport(c,s)}${elementAssessmentReport(c.elementAssessment)}${modernPracticalEvidenceReport(c)}<h2>出处与文化关联</h2>${c.citations.length?c.citations.map(r=>`<div class="quote">${esc(r.text)}<br><span class="muted">《${esc(r.title)}》 ${esc(r.chapter)} · 条目 ${esc(r.id)}</span></div>`).join(''):'<p>现代组合寓意：未引用特定古籍原句。</p>'}<h2>传统用字参考</h2><p>${esc(c.traditionalReason)}</p>${s.namingRules?.version===NAMING_RULE_V7_VERSION?'<div class="naming7-use-notes">':''}<h2>读写与使用提醒</h2><ul>${lines(c.warnings.length?c.warnings:['登记的普通话谐音词表未触发提醒；建议家人连读复核。'])}</ul>${s.namingRules?.version===NAMING_RULE_V7_VERSION?'</div>':''}${yueReadingReport(c.yueReading,!!c.yueHomophones||!!c.namePhoneticReviews?.reviews.yue)}${yueHomophoneReport(c.yueHomophones)}${namePhoneticReviewsReport(c.namePhoneticReviews)}${wordPronunciationReport(c.wordPronunciationReference)}${numerologyReport(c.numerology)}${nameImageryReport(c.imageReading)}${c.reviewNote?`<div class="revision"><b>起名师意见</b><p class="note">${esc(c.reviewNote)}</p></div>`:''}${c.meaning!==c.originalMeaning?`<div class="revision"><b>系统原始解释</b><p>${esc(c.originalMeaning)}</p></div>`:''}</section>`).join('')}
  ${sessionSourcesReport(s)}<section class="candidate"><h2>工作室复核意见</h2><p class="note">${esc(s.reviewNote||'尚未填写最终复核意见。')}</p><p>传统分析属于文化参考，语言印象因家庭与地域而异。用字、读音及最终姓名由家庭与起名师共同确认。</p><p class="muted">算法 ${esc(b.version)} / ${esc(q.version)} · 数据 ${esc(s.dataVersion)}</p><div class="footer">${esc(settings.studioName)} · ${esc(settings.contact)}<br>生成时来源登记见本报告；旧方案若未保存清单会明确提示。资料许可按各来源声明。</div></section></body></html>`;
}
